Airitos LLC is delivering an enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) design and implementation for a global manufacturing client and is seeking a contract implementation engineer with hands-on Delinea experience. This is the build role on the program: standing up core PAM infrastructure across two AD forests, onboarding privileged accounts at scale, and configuring session controls, integrations, and monitoring through to handoff.
The role is remote with little to no travel required. The engagement runs approximately 10 months, with delivery activity continuing through 2027. The engineer reports to the Airitos IAM/PAM Architect and works alongside the Airitos technical and process analysts and the client’s infrastructure, cybersecurity, and applications teams.
Environment

• Heavy Microsoft environment, mostly on-prem with some cloud presence

• Azure as the preferred cloud platform; AWS for SAP; Microsoft Entra ID (E5)

• Microsoft Sentinel for SIEM; ServiceNow for ITSM

• No enterprise PAM in place today; this is a greenfield Delinea deployment

Key Responsibilities

• Deploy and configure core Delinea infrastructure (Secret Server and supporting components) across both forests, including web/application and database tiers, distributed engines for segmented connectivity, and certificate-based trust between systems.

• Discover, import, and vault privileged accounts and non-human identities; configure automated password rotation policies; establish and test break-glass emergency access procedures.

• Configure privileged session brokering, session recording with defined retention, and least-privilege enforcement for critical systems and applications.

• Build just-in-time access workflows tied to ServiceNow approval.

• Integrate PAM session and audit activity with Microsoft Sentinel; configure alerting.

• Support integration design and build for Azure and development tooling connectivity.

• Track and report onboarding volume and pace as the account universe is brought under management.

• Produce operational runbooks, contribute to knowledge transfer, and support training and handoff to client staff.

Required Qualifications

• Hands-on Delinea implementation experience, specifically Delinea Secret Server (vault architecture, secret templates, rotation, discovery) and the Delinea Platform.

• Working knowledge of Delinea components including Distributed Engines, Connection Manager, session recording/monitoring, and Privilege Manager.

• Strong Windows Server and Active Directory background, including multi-forest environments; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID.

• Experience onboarding privileged accounts and configuring rotation policies at scale (thousands of accounts).

• PKI and certificate management, network segmentation concepts, and firewall-aware deployment across distributed sites.

• Scripting and automation with PowerShell and REST APIs.

• Experience integrating PAM tooling with a SIEM (syslog/CEF) and with an ITSM platform for approval workflows.

• Practical understanding of tiered administration (Tier 0 through Tier 3), the Microsoft Enterprise Access Model, just-in-time access, and least privilege.

Preferred Qualifications

• Delinea certification (Secret Server / Platform).

• Experience implementing PAM across disconnected or untrusted multi-forest AD environments.

• Familiarity with non-human identity and secrets management (service accounts, service principals, DevOps secrets).

• Azure and AWS exposure; awareness of Entra PIM and how it interacts with a PAM deployment.

• ServiceNow workflow integration experience.

• Awareness of regional privacy considerations for session recording.

• Experience producing operational runbooks and transitioning day-to-day ownership to a client operations team.

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer programs team as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. Data integration and ingestion

•

•
TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team

•
Journal of General Internal Medicine: A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs

About the Opportunity
Pair Team is hiring its second lawyer. As Associate General Counsel, you’ll work directly with our Head of Legal to build the legal function at a healthcare company that serves some of the most complex, highest-need patients, and you’ll shape how we scale.
Growing in this space means working through telehealth regulation, Medicaid and Medicare program requirements, privacy and data use, payer and provider contracting, and state-by-state licensure and operating rules. At a company our size, you won’t be a specialist in a silo or a reviewer at the end of the line - you’ll be a trusted partner to Product, Operations, Clinical, and the Executive team, helping them move quickly and with confidence. You’ll take on a wide range of matters, from regulatory strategy to complex payer agreements. You’ll also have real ownership. This role reports directly to the Head of Legal.

Legal & Regulatory Guidance

• Lead advisor on corporate, healthcare regulatory, litigation, commercial, product, employment, and privacy matters.

• Monitor regulatory developments and translate their impact into clear, actionable guidance for product, clinical, and operations teams.

• Collaborate with operational, clinical and marketing leaders to ensure adherence to applicable laws and regulations (e.g. HIPAA, Anti-Kickback, Corporate Practice of Medicine).

• Understand and provide business friendly guidance on use and impact of artificial intelligence and other technologies in healthcare programs.

Commercial Strategy & Contracting

• Work on contract development and negotiation-drafting, redlining, and advising on deal terms for health plans, vendors, and partners.

• Draft templates and playbooks for contracting with partners, including service agreements, BAAs, NDAs, and other agreements..

• Provide legal and regulatory guidance related to Medicaid, Medicare, value-based care, and product development to support commercial strategy.

Risk Identification & Building Out Legal Function

• Act as a trusted advisor to business, product, and clinical teams - flagging legal risks early and helping design compliant solutions rather than blocking progress.

title: Senior Learning Engineer
description:
The role
The Senior Learning Engineer combines ownership of an academic subject portfolio with direct people management and delivery oversight of an assigned team of Learning Engineers. Working within the Product team, they are responsible for maintaining high academic standards, developing and supporting their direct reports, and ensuring that agreed priorities are delivered effectively. They apply academic expertise, sound judgement and a continuous-improvement mindset to strengthen both the learning experience and the way their team works.
Key responsibilities
Learning engineering

• Retain direct academic ownership of an allocated portfolio of subjects and courses, including responsibility for their delivery, quality and alignment with relevant curriculum and regulatory requirements.

• Apply subject expertise, learning science, data and technology to develop, evaluate and improve learning experiences.

• Contribute to academic delivery, quality assurance and the development of effective tools, systems and ways of working.

People leadership

• Provide line management to an assigned team of Learning Engineers, including performance management, coaching, feedback and professional development.

• Establish and uphold clear expectations, address performance concerns and hold team members accountable for their responsibilities.

• Support recruitment, onboarding and relevant people-management processes.

• Build a collaborative, accountable and high-performing team.

Delivery and coordination

• Coordinate and oversee the team's work to ensure agreed priorities, deadlines and quality standards are met, while maintaining individual accountability for delivery.

• Allocate and reprioritise work, resolve issues within their authority, and escalate decisions requiring Product leadership's input with clear recommendations.

• Identify and address risks, dependencies and constraints that may affect delivery.

• Drive improvements in processes, practices and the effectiveness of academic work.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders to support the achievement of Product objectives.

• Use learner questions, engagement and assessment data to identify areas for improvement and prioritise the team's efforts accordingly.

Key requirements

• Relevant teaching qualification and SACE registration or eligibility.

• Experience in secondary education, with sound knowledge of the South African curriculum and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Demonstrated subject expertise and relevant secondary teaching experience, with the qualifications and capability to take direct academic ownership of an allocated portfolio of subjects and courses.

• Demonstrated leadership capability or potential, including experience supporting, mentoring or coordinating others. Previous formal management experience is not required.

• Strong organisational, communication and interpersonal skills.

• Sound judgement, initiative and the ability to make decisions, solve problems and manage competing priorities.

• Confidence using digital technologies and data responsibly to improve academic practice, in line with organisational policies.

• Adaptability and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

title: Inside Sales Representative

Abracon , LLC, is a leading supplier of RF, Timing & Magnetic Components to customers around the globe. At Abracon , we transform ideas into products that meet the opportunities of tomorrow.

• Partner with the Regional Sales Manager to develop and execute territory growth strategies and sales plans.

• Formulate quote strategies and negotiate pricing between customers, representatives, and distributors.

• Maintain accurate sales pipeline information and provide regular updates regarding opportunities, bookings, billings, forecasts, and market intelligence.

• Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer feedback, providing insights and recommendations to management.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Regional Sales Managers, Engineering, Technical Support, Customer Service, Product Management, and Operations teams to ensure customer satisfaction and successful order execution.

• Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales goals and performance objectives.
